_comment: Structured JSON of the Sorter (Flow 1) AI-classify step + SharePoint create step. Site Address = full URL 'https://fbcglenarden.sharepoint.com/sites/m365appbuilder-app-3155' (NOT the short name — the short form errors with 'Site Address ... is not valid'), list 'Inbox Action Register'. NOTE: the source prompt declared only 9 output keys but the SharePoint step maps 13 — outputContract below is the corrected 13-key set; update the prompt's 'these keys' line to match or owner/dueDateStated/recipientScope/triggerWordsHit return empty.

classifyEmailStep.name: Classify Email for Action Register

inputs.subject: When a new email arrives (V3) > Subject
inputs.from: When a new email arrives (V3) > From address
inputs.to: When a new email arrives (V3) > To
inputs.cc: When a new email arrives (V3) > Cc
inputs.body: When a new email arrives (V3) > Body preview

classifyEmailStep.persona: Classify one email for Gina Thomas, Business Systems & Solutions Manager, Business Services Dept (BSD), First Baptist Church of Glenarden. Return ONLY a JSON object. No prose.
classifyEmailStep.declaredKeysInstruction: Return ONLY a JSON object with these 13 keys and allowed values: businessCategory, digestLane, sourceSystem, pillar, actionOwner, owner, priority, status, dueDateStated, reviewed, recipientScope, confidence, triggerWordsHit.

outputContract.owner: <name/email of who owns the next step, or empty>
outputContract.dueDateStated: <ISO date YYYY-MM-DD if stated, else empty>
outputContract.recipientScope: Direct to Me | CC | Distribution List

rules.R1: Platform is NOT the category. Sending system (Smartsheet/NetSuite/NextProcess/Oracle/ADP/etc.) goes in sourceSystem; classify businessCategory by what the email is ABOUT.
rules.R2: A NetSuite/NextProcess/Oracle business transaction = the transaction category (requisition/PO=PROCUREMENT; bill/check/journal/invoice/past-due=FINANCE/AP; vendor record=VENDOR). Use SYSTEM only for platform notices (upgrade/config/integration/break).
rules.R3: Contract lifecycle steps (submit/review/approve/execute/renew-by/signature)=CONTRACTS; use LEGAL only for genuine counsel/policy/compliance.
rules.R5: Ministry Gina actively works (WCWC)=MINISTRY; broadcast church info (Funerals, digests, staff-meeting blasts)=FYI.
rules.R6: KEY. If Gina owns the next action -> actionOwner='Me' and an action lane. If she is only cc'd/informed -> actionOwner='Someone Else' (or 'None'), digestLane='FYI / Learning Reference', priority='Low', regardless of content. Direct-to-her outranks a distribution list.
rules.R7: NetSuite/NextProcess money item=FINANCE/AP; platform notice=SYSTEM; a request to design/acquire capability=AI / AUTOMATION DESIGN.
rules.R8: 'Build/revisit a process or form'=AI / AUTOMATION DESIGN; a request needing only a short reply=ACTION – Reply Needed.
rules.R9: Educational/how-to/AI-learning content or professional newsletters=FYI – Reference / Learning. Reserve PROMOTIONS / SUBSCRIPTIONS / MISC for consumer/vendor marketing (restaurants, salon, streaming sign-ups, product trials).
rules.R10: Routine IT-support tickets/equipment automations=FYI. A named person's request awaiting Gina's fulfillment=ACTION (Procurement or Approval).
rules.recipientScope: Direct to Me if gthomas@fbcglenarden.org is in To; CC if only in Cc; Distribution List if reached via a group/DL address.
rules.needsReview: If action-vs-FYI is genuinely unclear, or confidence < 60, set reviewed='No' and digestLane='Action Required'. Otherwise reviewed='Yes'.

priorityLogic.Critical: A system exception Gina owns, or subject has 'urgent'/'past due'/'immediate attention required'.
priorityLogic.High: Contract legal-review/approval/signature, renew-by, escalations, direct approval requests.
priorityLogic.Low: Anything actionOwner != 'Me', FYI, promotions, ministry broadcast, inspection reports.
priorityLogic._note: 'ACTION REQUIRED: CBO Master Initiative Tracker' is a routine status nudge -> REPORTING, Normal (not Critical).

classifyEmailStep.statusLogic: New if actionOwner='Me'; otherwise Reference. Use Waiting for WAITING items, Blocked for BLOCKED items.
